message.content:
### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough. Feel free to skip or reorder sections if you already have some components or experience. | # | Task | Key Points | |---|------|------------| | 1 | **Plan & Budget** | • Decide what you’ll use it for (gaming, video editing, office work).
• Set a budget (e.g., $800–$1500).
• Make a parts list (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, PSU, case, cooling). | | 2 | **Gather Tools & Workspace** | • Phillips screwdriver (magnetic tip).
• Anti‑static wrist strap (optional but recommended).
• Clean, flat surface with good lighting. | | 3 | **Choose a Case** | • Size: ATX, Micro‑ATX, Mini‑ITX.
• Airflow: front/mid intake fans, rear exhaust.
• Cable management features. | | 4 | **Install the Power Supply (PSU)** | • Place PSU at bottom rear (or top if case supports).
• Secure with screws.
• Route cables: keep them tidy, avoid blocking airflow. | | 5 | **Mount the Motherboard** | • Align standoffs with motherboard holes.
• Screw in standoffs first, then place motherboard.
• Tighten screws evenly. | | 6 | **Install CPU** | • Lift the CPU socket lever.
• Align the corner indicator on the CPU with the socket.
• Gently place CPU, lower lever. | | 7 | **Apply Thermal Paste & Install Cooler** | • If cooler doesn’t come pre‑applied, dab a pea‑size amount of paste on CPU.
• Mount cooler according to its instructions (fan‑first or back‑first).
• Connect fan power cable to CPU fan header. | | 8 | **Insert RAM** | • Open DIMM slots by pulling levers.
• Align notch on stick with slot.
• Push firmly until levers click. | | 9 | **Add Storage (SSD/HDD)** | • For M.2 SSD: insert into M.2 slot, screw down.
• For SATA SSD/HDD: mount in drive bay, connect SATA data + power cables. | | 10 | **Install Graphics Card (GPU)** | • Remove appropriate expansion slot covers.
• Insert GPU into PCI‑Express x16 slot, secure with screws.
• Connect 6‑pin/8‑pin power from PSU. | | 11 | **Connect Front Panel & USB** | • Refer to motherboard manual for exact pin layout.
• Connect power button, reset button, LEDs, USB headers, audio jacks. | | 12 | **Cable Management** | • Tidy up cables using Velcro ties or zip ties.
• Route cables through cable grommets.
• Ensure no obstruction of fans or vents. | | 13 | **First Boot & BIOS Setup** | • Connect monitor, keyboard, mouse.
• Power on.
• Enter BIOS (usually Delete/F2).
• Check that all components are recognized.
• Set boot priority to your OS installation media. | | 14 | **Install Operating System** | • Use a USB flash drive with Windows 10/11 or Linux installer.
• Follow on‑screen prompts.
• Install drivers (chipset, GPU, Wi‑Fi). | | 15 | **Test & Benchmark** | • Run stress tests (Prime95, FurMark) to ensure stability.
• Benchmark CPU/GPU (Cinebench, 3DMark).
• Monitor temperatures and fan speeds. | | 16 | **Final Adjustments** | • Update BIOS if needed.
• Install additional software (antivirus, utilities).
• Configure power settings for performance or energy saving. | --- #### Quick Tips & Common Pitfalls | Issue | Fix | |-------|-----| | **Static damage** | Use an anti‑static wrist strap or touch a grounded metal object before handling components. | | **Fan not spinning** | Check power cable connections; ensure fan header is enabled in BIOS. | | **Component not detected** | Verify proper seating, check for bent pins, update BIOS. | | **Overheating** | Ensure adequate airflow, reapply thermal paste, consider aftermarket cooler. | | **No display** | Confirm GPU is seated, monitor input source is correct, test with another cable. | #### Resources - **PCPartPicker** – Build lists, compatibility checks, price tracking. - **YouTube Channels** – Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents, Paul's Hardware. - **Manufacturer Manuals** – Always refer to the specific manual for each component. Happy building! If you hit a snag or need help choosing parts, just let me know.
message.reasoning: The user asks "How to build a new PC?" They want instructions. We can provide a general guide. No need to fetch recipe. Just give steps.
